parameters.jsCode: const input=$input.first().json||{}; const envelope=input.body||input; const req=envelope.normalized_github_execution_request_json||{}; const errors=[]; if(envelope.github_execution_request_json) errors.push('raw_github_execution_request_json_forbidden'); if(!(envelope.accepted===true&&envelope.validation_status==='pass')) errors.push('validated_normalized_github_execution_request_required'); if(req.repository_full_name!=='Viktoryyyyy/moex-robot') errors.push('repository_full_name_not_allowed'); if(req.base_ref!=='origin/main') errors.push('base_ref_must_equal_origin_main'); if(!String(req.branch_name||'').startsWith('n8n/')) errors.push('branch_name_must_use_n8n_prefix'); if(String(req.branch_name||'').startsWith('route-b/')||['main','master','refs/heads/main'].includes(String(req.branch_name||'').toLowerCase())) errors.push('branch_name_forbidden'); if(req.merge_authority!=='PM_L2_ONLY') errors.push('merge_authority_must_equal_PM_L2_ONLY'); for(const f of ['direct_main_write_allowed','force_push_allowed','file_delete_allowed','n8n_merge_allowed','executor_merge_allowed','server_apply_allowed','broker_execution_allowed','live_trading_allowed','runtime_allowed','production_secret_access_allowed','pm_l2_approval_claimed']){ if(req[f]!==false) errors.push(f+'_must_be_false'); } const files=Array.isArray(req.file_changes)?req.file_changes:[]; if(files.length!==1) errors.push('exactly_one_file_change_required'); if(errors.length){return [{json:{accepted:false,status:'blocked',validation_errors:errors,github_mutation_performed:false}}];} return [{json:{accepted:true,status:'validated',owner:'Viktoryyyyy',repo:'moex-robot',branch_name:req.branch_name,base_sha:req.base_sha,base_branch:'main',file_change:files[0],approved_for_merge:false,merge_performed:false}}];
